status: clarifying decision and accounting rules before all physical measurements

raw_macs.resource_filter: exact model bytes and uncalibrated QEMU PSRAM/internal heap
raw_macs.millisecond_budget_decisions: NA: raw MACs are not milliseconds

all_three_six_label_methods.resource_filter: same six-label median-residual calibrated PSRAM/internal heap for all methods, plus exact model bytes
all_three_six_label_methods.purpose: isolate the contribution of latency features; memory estimator held identical

oracle.resource_filter: actual query PSRAM/internal heap and exact model bytes

decision_rules.quality_filter: original INT8 validation top1 >= 0.90, not final image-test score
decision_rules.prediction_error_pool: all nine query networks, including out-of-support-feature-range examples; no post-hoc exclusion
decision_rules.memory_baseline_comparison: direct QEMU vs same-six median residual correction, evaluated independently of latency models

cost_accounting.shared_setup: report separately and disclose whether amortized; do not charge it only to the full-measurement baseline
cost_accounting.method_cost: shared setup plus six support acquisition costs plus feature extraction/fit/selection cost
cost_accounting.full_measurement_cost: same shared setup plus acquisition costs of all 15 plus direct selection cost
cost_accounting.evaluation_only_cost: nine query acquisition costs; report separately from six-label method decision cost
cost_accounting.claim: 60% fewer distinct architectures for calibration/decision; measured wall-clock savings need not be 60%
cost_accounting.sequential_baseline: all 15 measured on the same single device under the same protocol; no ideal parallel-device baseline

runtime_documentation.note: protocol.json timing reference is older API documentation; executable version is the pinned commit, not the citation version
